title.en: Tokens: how a model sees the world

subtitle.zh: 一句话进了模型，先被切碎再被计算——切法决定了成本、上限和怪癖。
subtitle.en: A sentence is chopped into tokens before a model reads it — the chopping drives cost, limits and quirks.

p.zh: 模型不读字母也不读词，读的是 token：高频词一整个 token，低频词被拆成几块。你看不见切法，但它在幕后决定一切。
p.en: Models read neither letters nor words but tokens: frequent words stay whole, rare ones split into pieces. You never see the cut, yet it drives everything.

p.zh: 计价按 token、上下文上限按 token、回复速度也按 token。同一个问题换个说法，token 数可能差一倍——这就是成本差一倍。
p.en: Pricing, context limits and speed are all counted in tokens. Rephrase a question and the token count can double — so can the cost.

p.zh: 让模型数字符经常出错，因为它看到的不是字符序列，是 token 序列——它得先「猜」每个 token 里有几个字母。
p.en: Models often miscount characters: they see token sequences, not letters, so they must guess how many characters hide inside each token.

p.zh: 打开任意 tokenizer 演示页（搜 “OpenAI tokenizer”），分别输入「人工智能」「AI」「artificial intelligence」，数一数各切成几个 token——用你自己的话解释为什么。
p.en: Open any tokenizer demo (search “OpenAI tokenizer”), type in 人工智能, AI and artificial intelligence, count the tokens, and explain the difference in your own words.

takeaway.zh: Token 是模型的记账单位：成本、上限、怪癖都从切法来。
takeaway.en: Tokens are the model's unit of account: cost, limits and quirks all follow from the cut.

hook.en: How many tokens is this sentence?

sentence.zh: 先把事看清，再把话说清。
sentence.en: Understand it first. Then explain it plainly.
